ddi_corpus.citation: Herrero-Zazo M, Segura-Bedmar I, Martínez P, Declerck T. The DDI corpus: an annotated corpus with pharmacological substances and drug-drug interactions. J Biomed Inform 46(5):914-920 (2013).
ddi_corpus.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (corpus README); evaluation only, not redistributed
ddi_corpus.unit: (sentence, document drug, partner drug name); interacting if any of its annotated mention pairs is

assignment_precision.definition: pairs the rule gives an outcome that the corpus annotates as interacting

unsupported_assignment_rate.definition: non-interacting pairs (co-mentioned only) the rule gives an outcome

coverage_of_interacting_pairs.definition: interacting pairs for which the rule finds a named outcome or exposure change
